List a filtered, paginated acquisition queue projection.

Source: R/acquisition_dashboard.R
acquisition_dashboard_jobs.Rd

List a filtered, paginated acquisition queue projection.

Usage

acquisition_dashboard_jobs(
  catalog,
  campaign_id = NULL,
  country = NULL,
  energy = NULL,
  state = NULL,
  portal = NULL,
  search = NULL,
  page = 1L,
  page_size = 50L
)

Arguments

catalog

A catalog from acquisition_catalog_open().

campaign_id

Optional campaign filter.

country

Optional source country filter.

energy

Optional normalized energy-kind filter.

state

Optional queue-state filter.

portal

Optional source portal filter.

search

Optional ID or target search string.

page

One-based page number.

page_size

Rows per page.

Value

A data frame with a total_count attribute.
